journey.name: usdt receive swipe tabs
journey.description:
On the Receive sheet, swiping sideways over the QR changes tabs on every tab, USDT included. With USDT selected, a swipe to the right over its QR selects the tab before it (Spending) and does not copy the address; a swipe to the left wraps around to the first tab (Savings), since USDT is the last tab. A single tap on the USDT QR still copies the address and shows the "copied" tooltip.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet with USDT enabled (introductory sheet or Settings, General, Payments), no CJIT invoice pending, start on the wallet home screen. The USDT address loads without funding; wait for the QR before swiping.
The copy shows as a tooltip over the QR for about two seconds, so a check for "no copy" reads a screenshot taken right after the swipe. Swipe with AXe (`axe swipe --start-x 80 --start-y 420 --end-x 320 --end-y 420 --duration 0.3 --udid <udid>` on a 390 pt wide simulator) across the middle of the QR, about 60% of its width. On a wallet without a Lightning channel, Spending shows its setup view instead of a QR.
iOS: the return from Spending to USDT goes through the paged `TabView`, which moves on a 300 ms swipe as well; the 600 ms in that step is kept so the two platforms run the same action. The final two iOS steps cover the flexible blank band between Edit/Copy/Share and Network. Use a tall phone at the default text size so that band is visible. Android attaches its swipe gesture to a full-height column; these extra steps guard the iOS spacer hit area.

actions.action: Tap the USDT tab (id "Tab-usdt") and wait until the USDT QR is visible
Swipe right across the QR and take a screenshot right away
Verify the Spending tab (id "Tab-spending") is selected, the Lightning receive content or the Spending setup is shown, and the screenshot shows no "copied" tooltip

Swipe left across the middle of the Spending content, whether it shows a Lightning QR or the Spending setup, in 600 ms (`axe swipe --start-x 320 --start-y 420 --end-x 80 --end-y 420 --duration 0.6`); verify the USDT tab is selected and wait until its QR is visible
Tap the USDT QR once and verify the "copied" tooltip appears
Wait until the tooltip is gone, swipe left across the USDT QR and take a screenshot right away; verify the Savings tab (id "Tab-savings") is selected and the screenshot shows no "copied" tooltip

Tap the USDT tab and wait for its QR. Locate the blank band between the Edit/Copy/Share row and Network, then swipe right through the middle of that band in 300 ms; verify Spending is selected and no "copied" tooltip appears
Tap the USDT tab again and wait for its QR. Swipe left through the same blank band in 300 ms; verify Savings is selected and no "copied" tooltip appears
